lines.text: Du hast bestimmt wieder kein Wasser dabei. Aber eine Meinung zur Hitze.
lines.meaning: New: sarcastic line at 11. A now line: the drawing shows heat. It shows on every screen with this drawing, the outfit alone included, so it has to make sense with nothing else on screen.

lines.text: Deine Laune schmilzt heute schneller als dein Eis.
lines.meaning: New: sarcastic line at 11. A now line: the drawing shows heat. It shows on every screen with this drawing, the outfit alone included, so it has to make sense with nothing else on screen.

lines.text: Traumwetter, und du suchst trotzdem schon die erste Wolke.
lines.meaning: New: sarcastic line at 11. A now line: the drawing shows a mild or warm outfit. It shows on every screen with this drawing, the outfit alone included, so it has to make sense with nothing else on screen.

lines.text: Um die Zeit fängst du wieder mit „Weißt du, was ich glaube?“ an. Nein. Schlaf.
lines.meaning: New: sarcastic line at 11. A now line: from 22:00, any weather. It shows on every screen with this drawing, the outfit alone included, so it has to make sense with nothing else on screen.

lines.text: Kalt ist's. Wie jedes Jahr, und jedes Jahr sind alle überrascht.
lines.hint: Proposed: only Oct–Dec (the first cold weeks (owner, round 11))
lines.meaning: A seasonal line. “Only in these months” shows it Oct–Dec only; “All year” leaves it be.

lines.text: Jedes Jahr wird's kalt. Und jedes Jahr tun alle überrascht.
lines.hint: Proposed: only Oct–Dec (the first cold weeks (owner, round 11))
lines.meaning: A seasonal line. “Only in these months” shows it Oct–Dec only; “All year” leaves it be.

lines.text: Schnee kommt. Deine Stiefel sind natürlich noch im Keller.
lines.hint: Proposed: only Oct–Dec (the first snow (owner, round 11))
lines.meaning: A seasonal line. “Only in these months” shows it Oct–Dec only; “All year” leaves it be.

lines.text: Bei der Kälte schmeckt sogar Glühwein.
lines.meaning: A seasonal line. “Only in these months” shows it Nov–Jan only; “All year” leaves it be.

lines.text: Bei der Kälte trinkt man sogar freiwillig Glühwein.
lines.meaning: A seasonal line. “Only in these months” shows it Nov–Jan only; “All year” leaves it be.
